entities.name: Frog
entities.description: A creature type for tailless, stout-bodied amphibians, including sapient frog-folk across the Multiverse.

entities.name: Burrog
entities.description: Frog-folk native to Doradur on Arcavios, found among Witherbloom, Quandrix and Prismari students and faculty.

entities.name: Frogfolk of the Valley
entities.description: Animalfolk of Bloomburrow known for water magic, augury and living in Fountainport.

entities.name: Glarb
entities.description: King of Fountainport and a powerful wizard who hired Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast's egg.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: A weaselfolk hired by Glarb to steal a Calamity Beast egg.

entities.name: Helga
entities.description: One of Glarb's apprentices, who assisted Mabel in her quest to stop him.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Hero who set out to stop Glarb.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: A frog corrupted into a hulking monstrosity by the spirit of a follower of Belzenlok.

entities.name: The Gitrog Monster
entities.description: An enormous frog of Nephalia on Innistrad, now on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Grolnok
entities.description: A massive frog in Nephalia worshipped as a deity.

entities.name: Tatsunari
entities.description: A Mukotai who became known as the Toad Rider after raising the toad Keimi as his mount.

entities.name: Keimi
entities.description: A corpse-swallower toad raised by Tatsunari to serve as his mount.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Ravnican guild that uses frogs as a favorite experimental resource.

events.summary: Glarb, king of Fountainport, hired Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast's egg to raise as the Valley's protector.
events.quote: He hired the weaselfolk Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast 's egg

events.summary: Helga assisted Mabel in her quest to stop Glarb.
events.quote: One of Glarb's apprentices, Helga , assisted Mabel in her quest to stop him.

events.summary: Yargle was created when a frog ate a transformed follower of Belzenlok, whose spirit corrupted it.
events.quote: Yargle was "born" when a frog ate a transformed ambitious follower of Belzenlok

events.summary: Tatsunari became the Toad Rider by raising the toad Keimi as his mount.
events.quote: The Mukotai Reckoner Tatsunari became known as the Toad Rider after raising the corpse-swallower toad Keimi to serve as his mount.
